test_cases.title: Successful Login with valid credentials
preconditions: The login page is open and accessible.
Valid test credentials are configured through environment variables.
The application is running and accessible.
The required Selenium browser environment is configured.
steps: Given the user is on the login page
When the user enters valid credentials and clicks the login button
Then the application should authenticate the user and display the dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated, the dashboard is displayed with title "Dashboard" and welcome message "Welcome to the QA Demo Application", and the login form is no longer visible
